about: Uploads use one App Attest key per install. Every request first does GET /api/challenge for a `challenge` that is good for 10 minutes. Payloads and keys are base64.

register_once.replies: 200 registered; 400 or 401 discard this key and make a new one; 503 try later with the same key

each_trip.signs: generateAssertion clientDataHash = SHA-256("rydar-pass-v1\n" + challenge + "\n" + payload bytes)

body.payload: <base64 of the exact JSON bytes of payload_decoded>

each_trip.limits: 1 to 2000 passes, body at most 512 KB
each_trip.replies: 200 stored; 400 or 413 never retry; 403 key unknown, register a new key; 401, 409, 503 retry later
